summary: iter-148 · EA v1.52 P0 execution-truth audit — all 14 source-level assertions + 5 live HTTP/motor E2E checks + frontend smoke PASS. Verified: (P0-1) EA ExecuteTrade now accepts TRADE_RETCODE_DONE_PARTIAL as a real partial open, calls PositionIdFromDeal(deal_tk) and FindPositionForTrade(trade_id, broker_symbol, ...) for netting recovery, computes opened via 'accepted || pos_id > 0' (retcode-only success gone); (P0-2) journal writes JSetTicket('K'|'D'|'Q', ...) for order/deal/position separately, SelectPositionById scans by POSITION_IDENTIFIER with ACCOUNT_MARGIN_MODE_RETAIL_HEDGING gating the symbol/side/volume netting fallback; (P0-6) JSetTicket splits ulong via 'ticket>>32' + '0xFFFFFFFF' and JGetTicket falls back to legacy single-double journals; (P0-3) MODIFY_SL intent is consumed only on 'success && stop_confirmed'; (P0-4) partial-close success gated on MathAbs(remaining-new_vol)<=step_tol with error 'volume_mismatch_after_partial_close' when broker retcode-accepted but volume wrong; (P0-5) crash recovery ORDER_SENT path calls FindPositionForTrade(magic + DEAL_COMMENT trade_id + symbol + side + volume + HistorySelect 2h window). Backend consumption verified live: seeded a real (bridge_token+trade) doc, POSTed v1.52 report with filled_volume=0.30 vs lot_size=1.00 → trade doc now has order_ticket/deal_ticket/position_id set, partial_fill=True, original_lot_size=1.00, lot_size=0.30. Duplicate-ticket guard tolerates order→position transition (payload.order_ticket==stored mt5_ticket ⇒ NOT duplicate) and correctly flags real dup (both differ ⇒ requires_reconciliation=True). Security: models.py password Field(min_length=8) enforced — /api/auth/register with 7-char pw returns 422, 8-char succeeds; admin/admin123 (8 chars exactly) still logs in cleanly (cookie set). No hardcoded /app/backend|/app/frontend paths in any test file (pytest run from /tmp passes). No raw str(e) leaked from account/crypto/diagnostic/market/nl/signal routes. Version 1.52 consistent across EA #property + EA_CLIENT_VERSION + bot_routes.LATEST_EA + diagnostic_routes.LATEST_EA + setup_routes.ea_latest_version + Accounts.jsx + EaVersionStrip.jsx; FENCING_MIN_EA stays '1.50'. MQL5 structural integrity: braces/parens/brackets balance with 0 errors after string+comment stripping. Frontend smoke: Bot Health page renders data-testid='execution-health-panel', Trades page shows TICKET column, Register form's native minLength=8 blocks 7-char submissions with 'Please lengthen this text to 8 characters or more'.

critical_code_review_comments: Good: ExecuteTrade's 'bool opened = (accepted || pos_id > 0)' means that even when the broker returns a non-DONE retcode but the deal actually opened a position (a real MT5 edge in high-latency conditions), the EA still recovers the position id and reports open — no orphan broker positions.

Good: JSetTicket's 64-bit split (ticket>>32 / &0xFFFFFFFF) plus a legacy single-double read path in JGetTicket means an EA upgrade from v1.51→v1.52 will not lose track of in-flight tickets in the journal (backward-compat verified in test_exact_64bit_ticket_storage).

Good: bridge_routes.py duplicate guard clause `int(payload.order_ticket or 0) != int(trade['mt5_ticket'])` — the AND-chain means a pre-1.52 trade whose stored mt5 was the ORDER ticket is not misclassified as a duplicate when v1.52 starts reporting position_id in mt5_ticket. This is the exact rollback-safety property required for a live fleet upgrade.
Good: ApplyModifySL now needs BOTH success and stop_confirmed to consume the intent — an accepted broker retcode with an unclamped SL still leaves the intent replayable, preventing silent SL loss.

Good: ApplyPartialClose verifies volume via MathAbs(remaining - new_vol) <= step_tol and emits a structured 'volume_mismatch_after_partial_close' error when the broker retcode-accepts but leaves an out-of-spec volume — a class of bug that was previously invisible.

Good: FindPositionForTrade widens the recovery search to DEAL_MAGIC + DEAL_COMMENT contains trade_id + DEAL_SYMBOL + DEAL_TYPE + DEAL_VOLUME + a 2h HistorySelect window. Under netting this is the only way to disambiguate crash-recovery reattachment.

Nit: /api/bridge/report partial-fill adoption sets `update['lot_size'] = filled` unconditionally when filled < requested — but no bookkeeping event is written to a submission history/audit log. Consider a companion doc write (e.g. into trade_events) so the risk desk can retroactively see 'partial fill accepted at t=X, requested=1.00, filled=0.30'.

Nit: test_no_raw_exception_strings_in_route_responses is a lint-style guardrail that allows-list bot_routes/quant_routes/shadow_routes as 'deliberate ValueError validation'. If a new route ever adds an accidental `detail=str(e)`, this test catches it, but a route that returns raw exception text via a custom exception handler wrapper would bypass it. Consider extending the check to catch `raise HTTPException(status_code=500, ...)` wrappers that reference str(exc).
